findings.headline: Age adjustment substantially reorders heart and brain country comparisons
findings.detail: Across 185 countries, crude versus standardized death-rate ranking rho is 0.030 for brain and 0.252 for heart. Rankings describe mapped burden, not health-system performance.

findings.headline: COVID-19 exceeds the net 2019–2021 increase in mapped lung deaths
findings.detail: Global broad-bin lung ASDR rose by 154.0 per 100,000. The COVID component rose by 168.8, while all other mapped lung causes together fell by 14.8. This is additive accounting, not a causal estimate.

findings.headline: The median country difference in brain ASDR is −15% with broad age bins
findings.detail: For brain, the median difference is -15.02% (country p05–p95 -25.92% to 5.65%). Reassigning diabetes moves pancreas from global death-ASDR rank 16 to 7; burden totals are unchanged.

findings.headline: Two reproducible patterns have modest separation and method-dependent membership
findings.detail: k=2 has silhouette 0.229 and median bootstrap ARI 0.936. Ward agreement is 0.396, so the split is a descriptive summary rather than a natural classification.

findings.headline: Sex contrasts depend on the group and burden measure
findings.detail: The global male/female mental/substance ASDR ratio is 3.56 for deaths and 1.03 for DALYs. For bones/joints DALYs it is 0.67. Sex-specific groups are excluded from these comparisons.
